meta.title: Canopi - Agroecological Design Tool
meta.description: Plan food forests, gardens and agroecological systems with Canopi. Free and open source for Linux, macOS and Windows, with a Web edition available in your browser.
footer.license: Free software under the AGPL-3.0 licence.
footer.association: Canopi is a non-profit association under French law (loi 1901).
network.title: Agroecology network
hero.tagline: Agroecological design, free and open to everyone
download.title: Get Canopi
download.pickMac: Which chip does your Mac have?
download.helpMac: Apple menu → About This Mac → Chip or Processor.
download.installWindows: Open the installer in your Downloads folder and follow the steps.
download.installMac: Open the .dmg, then drag Canopi into Applications.
download.installLinux: Allow the AppImage to run as a program in its file Properties, then open it.
download.installDeb: Open the .deb with your software installer and choose Install.
download.webText: Opens in your browser, nothing to install. A smaller plant catalog; your designs stay in this browser.
download.desktopText: The full plant catalog, terrain data and the Data library. Works offline.
design.title: Designed with Canopi
design.lede: Real places, planned layer by layer.
design.canvasLabel: Planting plan of {name}: {plants} plants of {species} species
design.hintPointer: Drag to explore · Ctrl + scroll to zoom
design.hintTouch: Tap a plant · two fingers to explore
finder.unavailable: The map could not load. The list shows the featured designs.
contact.title: Write to us
contact.lede: A design you'd like us to feature, a question, a translation to improve: we read everything.
contact.privacy: Your message is only used to reply to you.

donate.title: Support Canopi
donate.lede: Canopi is free for everyone. Donations go to Canopi, the non-profit association that develops it.
donate.tax: If you pay tax in France, 66% of your donation is deductible; HelloAsso sends you the tax receipt.
donate.pickMonthly: At the top of the form, choose “Monthly”.
donate.slow: The form is taking a while to load.
donate.thanksText: Your gift keeps Canopi free for everyone. HelloAsso emails you the receipt.
donate.foot: Payments are handled by HelloAsso, a French platform for non-profits.
donate.language: The form is in French and English: choose your language at the top of the form.
